rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Photoelectric emission happens only above the threshold frequency.
Einstein's equation: hν = W0 + KEmax.

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Maximum KE depends on frequency, not on intensity.  ·  Stopping potential measures KEmax: eV0 = hν − W0.
